close_reason: Replaced .expect on the response['list'] re-borrow with a let-else bail-out. Read-phase collects existing_ids/node_ids from an immutable borrow that drops before the .await; write-phase takes a fresh mutable borrow with let-else fallback. No behavioural change for the happy path; the panic-on-shape-mismatch case is now a graceful 'return the response as-is' which preserves the existing best-effort posture for an impossible-in-practice condition. Existing tests still cover both happy and error paths. Committed in 0aab25a. Gates: fmt/clippy/test/doc green.
